name: The Logistician
description: Ted Carmile reporting for duty. I'm the head of logistics of this here vessel and thus tasked with solving the problem of delivering items to and from your outpost, mostly stuff that is either too large or too hi-tech to be transferable by tablet alone. I have also been granted permission to siphon off a bit of our remaining cargo to help you in your mission. If you've done well, of course.

quests.name: Request Extraction
quests.description: If you ever get lost or just don't feel like walking back to base, I can use a bit of our power reserves to teleport you back, in a similar fashion as we send down clone bodies in case of your untimely demise. Since I'm also transporting your inventory and consciousness, this is a bit more limited, however, only sending you back to your Landing Site, not your spawnpoint. warning: may have unforeseen consequences when not used in overworld!

tasks.longDescription: I can grant this favor as long as your rep with the administration is positive.

quests.name: Inscriber Press Requisition
quests.description: When you get some power going, the leadership expects you to erect an ME system to serve as the centerpiece of your outpost. We can't mail you any supplies directly, but the presses should survive. We would need to make the initial batch out of something sturdy like titanium though so it isn't prone to burning up during reentry. Any more batches you'll make can be inscribed onto plain iron, though.

tasks.longDescription: In case you ever lose one, you can always request more.

quests.name: Bridge Repair
quests.description: Most Display Instruments and Consoles on the Bridges are irreparably damaged. We'll need you to replace them so we can regain control over the ship's systems.

tasks.longDescription: Hand us these items to get the repairs going:

quests.name: Fuel for the Fuel Tanks
quests.description: Now to the moment It's all been leading up to. Ship us the D-T fuel we need

quests.name: Advanced Item Transport
quests.description: For the larger shipments, we will need some better transportation tech.

tasks.longDescription: A dimensional transceiver strapped to your tablet should do.

quests.name: Reactor Maintenance
quests.description: As you might know, we had to vent most of our fuel supplies as the reactor fell apart from the planet's radiation. We'll have to replace basically the entire hull and pieces of the blast doors that didn't open in time.

tasks.longDescription: Send us the following items to start the repairs:

quests.name: Provisions Supply: Grain
quests.description: Help us top off our grain supplies. The crew can't stand replicated nutrient paste anymore and anything more flavorful would be too expensive for our remaining power.

tasks.longDescription: Please hand in these supplies:

quests.name: Emergency Supplies
quests.description: You may request some emergency rations to help you out if food or water ever get scarce for whatever reason. These nutrient blocks aren't exactly tasty or healthy, though.

tasks.longDescription: I will grant you this item as long as the mission isn't actively in Peril

quests.name: Quarters Rennovation
quests.description: The Quarters, while undamaged, are in desparate need of an upgrade. Since we'd normally rely on our electronic devices for entertainment, we didn't bring anything else to pass the time. Also the bedsheets are long overdue for a wash. Would you like to assist?

tasks.longDescription: Send me these items:

quests.name: Cooling System Repair
quests.description: Without the cooling systems, it is impossible to run the Fatality Engine on higher settings than "Puny orbital laser". Fortunately, they don't seem to have received much damage due to their relatively small footprint.

tasks.longDescription: Send us the following items to start the repairs:

quests.name: Cloning Supplies
quests.description: Since we are on a bit of a tight budget, we can't just keep printing out replicas of you and your crewmates forever. Every time we do, that is a lot of resources that could've gone towards repairing the ship, make it more livable for long-term stays, not to mention the toll the biomass requirements take on our rations. Until we get some sort of direct shipment of useful organs and meat, every life you have available will lower your reputation.

tasks.longDescription: You can request more Lives as long as the mission is ongoing. If Hardcore mode isn't enabled, you won't need this.

quests.name: Reference material
quests.description: As the technology of the Questing tablet is quite limited, some things, like graphics, simply can't be displayed. in case the info in Collins' tab is not enough for you, you can request a printed version compiled by them and the other researchers all about the wonders of the natural world around you.

tasks.longDescription: You may request this as long as your mission isn't "In Peril"

quests.name: Crude Orbital Shipping
quests.description: Like Collins probably told you already, there is no way for you to send us items, be they for ship repairs, extra rations, or for research. I think I might've come up with a solution though. Not an elegant one, looking at our current lack of dimensional teleportation tech on your end, but it will suffice, at least for small amounts of items.

tasks.longDescription: Would you be so kind to strap an Air Cannon to your Tablet?

quests.name: Request Scrap
quests.description: I've heard you are having problems obtaining metal. Fortunately, the whole damn ship is made out of the stuff, and I could send you some scrap from the damaged sections. It is, however, very dangerous for our crew to go and retrieve them.

tasks.longDescription: As long as the mission is not going badly, the requested materials will be salvaged for you.

quests.name: FE Dish Repair
quests.description: The Focusing Dish for the Fatality Engine is largely unharmed by direct fire, but debris from our initial, not so clean strike against the Rig have broken some of the mirrors. without it, we can hardly control the projectile that the weapon produces on higher settings.

tasks.longDescription: Please send us the following items to start the repairs:

quests.name: FE Barrel Repair
quests.description: The Fatality Engine's Barrel contains some sensitive components that have been ravaged by the planet's magic. If you repair it, we can use it on a low setting and send down laser beams at locations you desire. if you reimburse us for the power cost, of course.
